title: The Gentle Creeper • Mayflower Studios
tagline: A non-exploding creeper who just wanted a friend.

heroTiles.title: 👋 Just Wants to Say Hi
heroTiles.body: A new creeper variant that walks up to players peacefully, curious and friendly instead of explosive.

heroTiles.title: 💥 No Explosions. Ever.
heroTiles.body: Gentle Creepers look exactly like normal creepers — but they will never explode.

heroTiles.title: 🌿 Familiar, Not Fearful
heroTiles.body: Same iconic creeper look. Completely different behavior. No jump scares, no griefing.

heroTiles.title: 🧩 Simple & Vanilla-Friendly
heroTiles.body: Adds one new mob with clean behavior changes that feel right at home in Minecraft.

descriptionHtml:
The Gentle Creeper doesn’t replace or alter vanilla creepers — it introduces a brand-new creeper variant with a softer nature.

Regular creepers remain just as dangerous as ever. This mod simply allows the world to occasionally spawn a gentler green friend alongside the usual chaos.

Gentle Creepers look exactly like normal creepers, but they don’t explode. Instead, they quietly wander up to players just to say hello.

Perfect for cozy playthroughs and friendly servers, this mod adds small, wholesome moments without removing Minecraft’s tension.

Sometimes you get a jumpscare. Sometimes… you get a creeper that just stands there like, “hi.”

features.title: 🟢 A Familiar Face, A Kinder Soul
features.desc: Gentle Creepers look identical to vanilla creepers, keeping the iconic green design intact. The difference is entirely in their behavior — they don’t hiss, don’t chase, and never explode. Instead, they calmly wander up to players as if they just want to say hello, creating quiet, wholesome moments where tension used to be.

features.title: 🌱 Wholesome Moments Without Losing Danger
features.desc: This mod doesn’t remove Minecraft’s threat or challenge. Normal creepers still spawn and behave exactly as expected. Gentle Creepers simply appear alongside them, adding contrast — sometimes danger, sometimes kindness — making the world feel more alive, surprising, and emotionally varied without disrupting gameplay balance.

install.calloutBody: Keep client and server versions in sync for consistent behavior.
install.stepsCode:
1) Install Forge (matching your Minecraft version)
2) Drop The Gentle Creeper into /mods
3) Launch once to generate config
4) Restart after config changes
